label: Renouncing worldly desire need not cancel love for an enemy
text: Read together, the two demands distinguish disordered desire from a person to be loved. This interpretation makes room for both commands in this ritual; it does not settle every question about matter or prove a verdict against dualist cosmologies.
attribution: Editorial interpretation of the juxtaposition — Lyon PA 36 ritual IV.32, 34–38; not an independently stated scholastic distinction in the manuscript.

sources.title: Occitan ritual, Lyon PA 36, Marvyn Roy Harris critical edition (Rialto)
